## Objective
- Finish and significantly upgrade the five-track rhythm game, with major polish for INTENTION, its boss presentation, menus, story characters, and a new high-density Chaos mode.

## Requirements
- Optimize heartbeat line effects so they preserve visual quality without causing frame lag.
- Improve the INTENTION boss map and cutscenes substantially.
- Add an INTENTION “Chaos mode” menu option with 1200 notes, advanced gimmicks, brand-new polished animation, no intro animation, normal gameplay notes, flying particles, far-gliding dynamic cutscenes, crazy multitouch gameplay, and at least 120 hold notes.
- Improve floating guilt memories with 1, 2, and unknown glitch-style main-character pictures.
- Add partner switching to the main menu.
- Add a two-partner story and band lore: the first main character faces a dying/unpopular band, while the second partner has limited social contact with them and a third partner is missing.
- Make both partners polished anime characters with accessories.

## Decisions
- Keep the authored chart section maps and gimmick event scores; extend or regenerate charts through `tools/build-game-charts.mjs`.
- Keep global tap/click/key input: the closest pending note is claimed rather than requiring lane-specific tapping.
- Keep the wall-clock game-over sequence at approximately 3.7 seconds.
- Use 1-lane and 2-lane active sets for INTENTION sections; 1-lane currently targets lane 3 and 2-lane targets lanes 2 and 4.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built and validated all five playable tracks with passing production builds.
- Perfect-clear validated CRYOUT, WORLD, CHRONOSTASIS, UNTOUCHABLE, and INTENTION under accelerated autoplay.
- Restored the fail state, tape-stop, camera pullback, `SIGNAL LOST` flatline, and results flow.
- Verified INTENTION’s textless gameplay HUD, overture/dawn cards, meters, effects, and dawn finish.
- Verified menu track switching, pause/resume, quit, retry, persistent personal bests, and all-track clear tracking.
- Verified mobile portrait rendering at 390×844 with no horizontal overflow.
- Fixed 1-lane and 2-lane pad affordances so inactive INTENTION lanes are hidden rather than exposing all eight pads.

### Active
- The new 1200-note INTENTION Chaos chart and at least 120 hold notes remain to be implemented.
- Boss map, character art, guilt memories, dynamic cutscenes, partner selection, story, and advanced Chaos gimmicks remain to be designed and built.
- Heartbeat and particle effects need profiling and optimization.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add a Chaos mode entry for INTENTION to the menu and track metadata.
2. Build and validate a 1200-note Chaos chart with at least 120 holds and a dedicated advanced-gimmick event pass.
3. Replace the INTENTION intro presentation with normal gameplay notes, flying particles, and gliding far-position cutscene choreography.
4. Upgrade the boss map, floating guilt memories, and glitch-character imagery.
5. Add partner switching, polished two-partner anime presentation, accessories, and the band-dying/missing-third-partner lore.
6. Profile heartbeat and particle rendering, then optimize batching, update frequency, geometry, and effects while preserving graphics quality.
7. Rebuild and run browser, accelerated-autoplay, mobile, and cutscene validation across normal and Chaos mode.

## Relevant Files
- `src/intention-stage.js`: INTENTION boss, GUILT phases, guilt meters, heartbeat, fake guilt, glitch, dawn, and cutscene effects.
- `src/scene.js`: Rendering, lane geometry, boss scenes, particles, cameras, cutscenes, and heartbeat-heavy visual systems.
- `src/main.js`: Gameplay, chart events, input, pause/retry, health, Chaos integration, and lane/section handling.
- `src/style.css`: INTENTION textless HUD, boss presentation, menus, overlays, and visual polish.
- `index.html`: Main menu, track cards, Chaos mode UI, controls, partner selection, and results markup.
- `src/tracks.js`: Track metadata and chart registration.
- `src/charts/intention.js`: Current INTENTION chart data.
- `tools/build-game-charts.mjs`: Canonical chart generator.
- `tools/build-intention-chart.mjs`: INTENTION-specific chart generation.
- `tools/source/gimmick-events.json`: Preserved boss/gimmick event data.
- `tools/source/section-maps.json`: Authored visual and lane section maps.
- `package.json`: Build and chart scripts.
- `README.md`: Gameplay, chart pipeline, and project documentation.
- `dist/`: Production bundle requiring a fresh rebuild.

## Important Context
- Latest known checkpoint commit: `b4d86f9` on branch `opencode/44932822312`; the worktree was clean at the start of the latest continuation.
- Post-clean edits changed the 1-lane/2-lane active-pad behavior in `src/main.js` and rebuilt the production bundle.
- Browser validation should continue to use 4× accelerated autoplay for chart coverage.
- INTENTION gameplay text must remain hidden while overture/dawn title cards and visual meters/effects remain visible.

## Objective
- Finish and significantly upgrade the existing five-track rhythm game, especially INTENTION’s boss presentation and a new high-density Chaos mode.

## Requirements
- Add an INTENTION Chaos mode with 1200 notes, at least 120 holds, advanced gimmicks, polished animation, normal gameplay notes, flying particles, gliding cutscenes, and multitouch gameplay.
- Improve INTENTION’s boss map, cutscenes, floating guilt memories, and glitch-style character imagery.
- Add main-menu partner switching, two polished anime partners with accessories, and band lore involving a dying/unpopular band and a missing third partner.
- Optimize heartbeat and particle effects without sacrificing visual quality.
- Continue global tap/click/key input: claim the closest pending note rather than requiring lane-specific tapping.

## Decisions
- Preserve authored chart section maps and gimmick event scores; extend or regenerate charts through `tools/build-game-charts.mjs`.
- Keep the wall-clock game-over sequence at approximately 3.7 seconds.
- Use 1-lane and 2-lane active sets for INTENTION sections; 1-lane targets lane 3 and 2-lane targets lanes 2 and 4.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built and validated all five playable tracks; production builds passed.
- Perfect-clear validated CRYOUT, WORLD, CHRONOSTASIS, UNTOUCHABLE, and INTENTION with accelerated autoplay.
- Restored the fail state, tape-stop, camera pullback, `SIGNAL LOST` flatline, and results flow.
- Verified INTENTION’s textless gameplay HUD, overture/dawn cards, meters, effects, and dawn finish.
- Verified menu track switching, pause/resume, quit, retry, persistent personal bests, and all-track clear tracking.
- Verified mobile portrait rendering at 390×844 without horizontal overflow.
- Fixed 1-lane and 2-lane pad affordances so inactive INTENTION lanes are hidden.

### Active
- Add the 1200-note INTENTION Chaos chart, at least 120 holds, advanced gimmicks, and a menu entry.
- Upgrade INTENTION’s boss map, guilt memories, glitch-character imagery, and far-position gliding cutscenes.
- Add partner selection, polished partner art, and the requested band story/lore.
- Profile and optimize heartbeat and particle rendering.
- Rebuild and validate normal and Chaos gameplay, cutscenes, autoplay, and mobile layouts.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Add Chaos mode to the INTENTION menu and track metadata.
2. Generate and validate the 1200-note Chaos chart with at least 120 holds and a dedicated advanced-gimmick event pass.
3. Build the Chaos presentation, including normal gameplay notes, flying particles, and gliding cutscene choreography.
4. Upgrade the boss map, guilt memories, glitch imagery, partner switching, character presentation, and story.
5. Profile and optimize heartbeat and particle effects.
6. Rebuild and run browser, accelerated-autoplay, mobile, and cutscene validation for normal and Chaos modes.

## Relevant Files
- `src/intention-stage.js`: INTENTION boss, GUILT phases, meters, heartbeat, glitch, dawn, and cutscene effects.
- `src/scene.js`: Rendering, boss scenes, particles, cameras, cutscenes, and heartbeat-heavy systems.
- `src/main.js`: Gameplay, chart events, input, pause/retry, health, Chaos integration, and lane/section handling.
- `src/style.css`: INTENTION HUD, boss presentation, menus, overlays, and visual styling.
- `index.html`: Main menu, track cards, Chaos UI, partner selection, and results markup.
- `src/tracks.js`: Track metadata and chart registration.
- `src/charts/intention.js`: Current INTENTION chart data.
- `tools/build-game-charts.mjs`: Canonical chart generator.
- `tools/build-intention-chart.mjs`: INTENTION-specific chart generation.
- `tools/source/gimmick-events.json`: Preserved boss/gimmick event data.
- `tools/source/section-maps.json`: Authored visual and lane section maps.
- `package.json`: Build and chart scripts.
- `README.md`: Gameplay, chart pipeline, and project documentation.
- `dist/`: Production bundle to refresh after changes.

## Important Context
- Latest known checkpoint commit is `b4d86f9` on branch `opencode/44932822312`; subsequent 1-lane/2-lane active-pad edits and a production rebuild were made after that checkpoint.
- INTENTION gameplay text must remain hidden while overture/dawn title cards and visual meters/effects remain visible.
- Browser chart validation has used 4× accelerated autoplay.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Finish and significantly upgrade the existing five-track rhythm game, especially INTENTION’s boss presentation and a high-density Chaos mode.

## Requirements
- Add INTENTION Chaos mode with 1200 notes, at least 120 holds, advanced gimmicks, polished animation, normal gameplay notes, flying particles, gliding cutscenes, and multitouch gameplay.
- Improve INTENTION’s boss map, cutscenes, floating guilt memories, and glitch-style character imagery.
- Add main-menu partner switching, two polished anime partners with accessories, and band lore about a dying/unpopular band and a missing third partner.
- Optimize heartbeat and particle effects without sacrificing visual quality.
- Keep global tap/click/key input: claim the closest pending note rather than requiring lane-specific tapping.

## Decisions
- Preserve authored chart section maps and gimmick event scores; extend or regenerate charts through `tools/build-game-charts.mjs`.
- Keep the wall-clock game-over sequence at approximately 3.7 seconds.
- Use 1-lane and 2-lane active sets for INTENTION sections; 1-lane targets lane 3 and 2-lane targets lanes 2 and 4.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built and validated all five playable tracks; production builds passed.
- Perfect-clear validated CRYOUT, WORLD, CHRONOSTASIS, UNTOUCHABLE, and standard INTENTION with accelerated autoplay.
- Restored the fail state, tape-stop, camera pullback, `SIGNAL LOST` flatline, and results flow.
- Verified INTENTION’s textless gameplay HUD, overture/dawn cards, meters, effects, and dawn finish.
- Verified menu track switching, pause/resume, quit, retry, persistent personal bests, and all-track clear tracking.
- Verified mobile portrait rendering at 390×844 without horizontal overflow.
- Fixed 1-lane and 2-lane pad affordances so inactive INTENTION lanes are hidden.
- Added Chaos chart generation and generated a chart with exactly 1200 notes, 150 holds, 167 events, 13 sections, and chords up to 3 notes; `node tools/build-chaos-chart.mjs` completed successfully.
- Added Chaos chart selection, menu mode markup, partner selection/story data, character art, guilt/glitch/glide presentation scaffolding, and Chaos styling.

### Active
- Validate that Chaos mode works end-to-end: menu activation, chart selection, input/multitouch, gimmick events, flying particles, cutscenes, and gameplay.
- Profile and optimize heartbeat and particle rendering.
- Run production build and validate standard/Chaos gameplay, cutscenes, autoplay, and mobile layouts.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect the current diff and resolve any remaining Chaos-mode integration or presentation issues.
2. Run the production build and available browser/autoplay validation for both INTENTION modes.
3. Profile heartbeat/particle systems and optimize if needed while preserving visual quality.
4. Verify mobile layout and report final validation results.

## Relevant Files
- `src/charts/intention.js`: Standard INTENTION chart.
- `src/charts/intention-chaos.js`: Generated Chaos chart.
- `tools/build-chaos-chart.mjs`: Chaos chart generator; most recently run successfully.
- `tools/build-game-charts.mjs`: Canonical chart generator.
- `tools/source/gimmick-events.json`: Preserved boss and gimmick event data.
- `tools/source/section-maps.json`: Authored visual and lane section maps.
- `src/tracks.js`: Track metadata and Chaos chart registration.
- `src/main.js`: Gameplay, chart events, input, menus, pause/retry, and Chaos integration.
- `src/intention-stage.js`: INTENTION boss, guilt phases, meters, heartbeat, glitch, dawn, and cutscene effects.
- `src/scene.js`: Rendering, boss scenes, particles, cameras, cutscenes, and heartbeat-heavy systems.
- `src/partners.js`: Partner profiles, accessories, and band lore.
- `src/style.css`: Menus, overlays, partner presentation, Chaos styling, and INTENTION HUD.
- `index.html`: Main menu, track cards, Chaos UI, partner selection, and results markup.
- `tools/build-intention-chart.mjs`: Standard INTENTION chart generation.

## Important Context
- Latest checkpoint commit is `b4d86f9` on branch `opencode/44932822312`; subsequent changes remain uncommitted.
- The current working tree includes source changes and generated/untracked assets; `dist` also contains changed/deleted generated files.

- Browser chart validation has previously used 4× accelerated autoplay.

## Objective
- Finish and significantly upgrade the existing five-track rhythm game, especially INTENTION’s boss presentation and a high-density Chaos mode.

## Requirements
- Add INTENTION Chaos mode with exactly 1200 notes, at least 120 holds, advanced gimmicks, polished animation, normal gameplay notes, flying particles, gliding cutscenes, and multitouch gameplay.
- Improve INTENTION’s boss map, cutscenes, floating guilt memories, and glitch-style character imagery.
- Add main-menu partner switching, two polished anime partners with accessories, and band lore about a dying/unpopular band and a missing third partner.
- Optimize heartbeat and particle effects without sacrificing visual quality.
- Keep global tap/click/key input: claim the closest pending note rather than requiring lane-specific tapping.
- Preserve authored chart section maps and gimmick event scores; extend or regenerate charts through `tools/build-game-charts.mjs`.
- Keep the wall-clock game-over sequence at approximately 3.7 seconds.
- Keep INTENTION gameplay text hidden while overture/dawn title cards and visual meters/effects remain visible.

## Decisions
- Use 1-lane and 2-lane active sets for INTENTION sections; 1-lane targets lane 3 and 2-lane targets lanes 2 and 4.
- Keep Chaos as a menu-selected chart swap while sharing INTENTION audio, stage, and partner story.
- Chaos starts directly in gameplay without the standard overture.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built and validated all five playable tracks; standard production builds passed.
- Perfect-clear validated CRYOUT, WORLD, CHRONOSTASIS, UNTOUCHABLE, and standard INTENTION with accelerated autoplay.
- Restored the fail state, tape-stop, camera pullback, `SIGNAL LOST` flatline, and results flow.
- Verified INTENTION’s textless gameplay HUD, overture/dawn cards, meters, effects, and dawn finish.
- Verified menu track switching, pause/resume, quit, retry, persistent personal bests, and all-track clear tracking.
- Verified mobile portrait rendering at 390×844 without horizontal overflow; inactive INTENTION lanes are hidden in 1-lane and 2-lane sections.
- Added Chaos chart generation and chart selection; `node tools/build-chaos-chart.mjs` generated exactly 1200 notes, 150 holds, 167 events, 13 sections, and max chord size 3.
- Added partner selection/story data, character art, guilt/glitch/glide presentation scaffolding, and Chaos styling.
- Most recent `npm run build` succeeded; Vite reported a chunk-size warning for the 793.52 kB JS bundle.

### Active
- Validate Chaos end-to-end in browser: menu activation, chart selection, input/multitouch, gimmick events, flying particles, cutscenes, gameplay, and mobile layout.
- Profile and optimize heartbeat and particle rendering while preserving visual quality.
- Review generated build output and working-tree changes; source and generated assets remain uncommitted.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect remaining Chaos integration and presentation details, then run browser/autoplay validation for both INTENTION modes.
2. Profile heartbeat and particle systems and optimize if needed.
3. Recheck mobile layouts and the production build; report validation results and note the bundle warning.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: gameplay input, chart events, menus, pause/retry, and Chaos integration.
- `src/intention-stage.js`: INTENTION boss, guilt phases, meters, heartbeat, glitch, dawn, and cutscene effects.
- `src/scene.js`: rendering, boss scenes, particles, cameras, cutscenes, and heartbeat-heavy systems.
- `src/charts/intention.js`: standard INTENTION chart.
- `src/charts/intention-chaos.js`: generated Chaos chart.
- `tools/build-chaos-chart.mjs`: deterministic Chaos chart generator.
- `tools/build-game-charts.mjs`: canonical chart generator.
- `tools/source/gimmick-events.json`: preserved boss and gimmick event data.
- `tools/source/section-maps.json`: authored visual and lane section maps.
- `src/tracks.js`: track metadata and Chaos chart registration.
- `src/partners.js`: partner profiles, accessories, and band lore.
- `src/style.css`: menus, overlays, partner presentation, Chaos styling, and INTENTION HUD.
- `index.html`: main menu, track cards, Chaos UI, partner selection, and results markup.
- `public/art/`: self-contained partner character SVG assets.

## Important Context
- Latest checkpoint commit is `b4d86f9` on branch `opencode/44932822312`; subsequent changes remain uncommitted, including generated `dist` output.
- Chaos chart generation last reported 1200 notes, 150 holds, 167 events, and max chord size 3.
- `npm run build` passed; warning: chunk exceeds 500 kB.
- Global pointer input uses `pressGlobal()` and claims the closest pending note; multitouch tracking uses `touchPoints`.
- Heartbeat logic is in `src/main.js` around `intent.heartOn`; particle updates are in `src/scene.js` around the `// particles` loop.

messages.summary:
## Objective
- Finish and significantly upgrade the existing five-track rhythm game, especially INTENTION’s boss presentation and a high-density Chaos mode.

## Requirements
- Add INTENTION Chaos mode with exactly 1200 notes, at least 120 holds, advanced gimmicks, polished animation, normal gameplay notes, flying particles, gliding cutscenes, and multitouch gameplay.
- Improve INTENTION’s boss map, cutscenes, floating guilt memories, and glitch-style character imagery.
- Add main-menu partner switching, two polished anime partners with accessories, and band lore about a dying/unpopular band and a missing third partner.
- Optimize heartbeat and particle rendering without sacrificing visual quality.
- Keep global tap/click/key input: claim the closest pending note rather than requiring lane-specific tapping.
- Preserve authored chart section maps and gimmick event scores; extend or regenerate charts through `tools/build-game-charts.mjs`.
- Keep the wall-clock game-over sequence at approximately 3.7 seconds.
- Keep INTENTION gameplay text hidden while overture/dawn title cards and visual meters/effects remain visible.

## Decisions
- Use 1-lane and 2-lane active sets for INTENTION sections; 1-lane targets lane 3 and 2-lane targets lanes 2 and 4.
- Keep Chaos as a menu-selected chart swap while sharing INTENTION audio, stage, and partner story.
- Chaos starts directly in gameplay without the standard overture.

## Work State
### Completed
- Built and validated all five playable tracks; standard production builds passed.
- Perfect-clear validated CRYOUT, WORLD, CHRONOSTASIS, UNTOUCHABLE, and standard INTENTION with accelerated autoplay.
- Restored the fail state, tape-stop, camera pullback, `SIGNAL LOST` flatline, and results flow.
- Verified INTENTION’s textless gameplay HUD, overture/dawn cards, meters, effects, and dawn finish.
- Verified menu track switching, pause/resume, quit, retry, persistent personal bests, and all-track clear tracking.
- Verified mobile portrait rendering at 390×844 without horizontal overflow; inactive INTENTION lanes are hidden in 1-lane and 2-lane sections.
- Added Chaos chart generation and chart selection; generated chart has exactly 1200 notes, 150 holds, 167 events, 13 sections, and max chord size 3.
- Added partner selection/story data, character art, guilt/glitch/glide presentation scaffolding, and Chaos styling.
- Latest `npm run build` succeeded; Vite reports a 793.52 kB JavaScript chunk-size warning.

### Active
- Validate Chaos end-to-end in browser, including menu activation, chart selection, input/multitouch, gimmicks, particles, cutscenes, gameplay, and mobile layout.
- Profile and optimize heartbeat and particle systems while preserving visual quality.
- Review generated build output and working-tree changes; source and generated assets remain uncommitted.

### Blocked
- (none)

## Next Move
1. Inspect remaining Chaos integration and presentation details, then run browser/autoplay validation for both INTENTION modes.
2. Profile heartbeat and particle systems and optimize if needed.
3. Recheck mobile layouts and the production build; report validation results and note the bundle warning.

## Relevant Files
- `src/main.js`: gameplay input, chart events, menus, pause/retry, and Chaos integration.
- `src/intention-stage.js`: INTENTION boss, guilt phases, meters, heartbeat, glitch, dawn, and cutscene effects.
- `src/scene.js`: rendering, boss scenes, particles, cameras, cutscenes, and heartbeat-heavy systems.
- `src/charts/intention.js`: standard INTENTION chart.
- `src/charts/intention-chaos.js`: generated Chaos chart.
- `tools/build-chaos-chart.mjs`: deterministic Chaos chart generator.
- `tools/build-game-charts.mjs`: canonical chart generator.
- `tools/source/gimmick-events.json`: preserved boss and gimmick event data.
- `tools/source/section-maps.json`: authored visual and lane section maps.
- `src/tracks.js`: track metadata and Chaos chart registration.
- `src/partners.js`: partner profiles, accessories, and band lore.
- `src/style.css`: menus, overlays, partner presentation, Chaos styling, and INTENTION HUD.
- `index.html`: main menu, track cards, Chaos UI, partner selection, and results markup.
- `public/art/`: self-contained partner character SVG assets.

## Important Context
- Latest checkpoint commit is `b4d86f9` on branch `opencode/44932822312`; subsequent changes remain uncommitted, including generated `dist` output.
- Chaos chart generation last reported 1200 notes, 150 holds, 167 events, and max chord size 3.
- The latest `npm run build` passed; warning: chunk exceeds 500 kB.
- Global pointer input uses `pressGlobal()` and claims the closest pending note; multitouch tracking uses `touchPoints`.
